name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a gold exploration company based in Reno, Nevada, that combines direct property exploration with royalty interests across Nevada and Idaho. The company's primary focus is the Lapon Canyon project in Nevada's Walker Lane shear zone, where it holds a 50% earn-in agreement and a 3% NSR royalty, with an active 2026 drill program targeting intrusive-related gold deposits. The company is at the exploration stage.
